narrative.headline: Structure complaints lead the 2018 Ford Explorer, with engine fumes a safety concern
narrative.summary: Of 699 owner complaints filed with NHTSA, structure problems are the most common by far at 282 reports (40%), including 4 crashes. The engine is the next biggest concern at 91 reports (13%), and notably accounts for 2 fires, 2 crashes, and 4 injuries. The electrical system follows at 56 reports (8%), also with 2 fires and 2 crashes. Power train and engine cooling round out the top issues. Buyers should inspect the body and structure closely and pay attention to the engine, where the most injuries are concentrated.
